column1: # tools/timing/cases_l2.tsv -- Level 2 measurement cases, one per application.
# Tab-separated. "-" means empty (a bare empty field would be swallowed: tab is an
# IFS whitespace character, so runs of tabs collapse in `IFS=$'\\t' read`).
#   timeout_s    hard limit for the profiled run (nsys costs ~1.7x, see README)
#   fom_name     name of the metric the application prints itself, "-" if it has none
#   fom_unit     unit as the application states it
#   fom_better   higher | lower  (a grind time is better when lower)
#   fom_source   stdout, or a glob relative to the run cwd for a file-reported metric
#   fom_regex    python regex with exactly one capture group; the LAST match wins
#   notes        for apps without a FOM: what they do print, so it is not lost
# The FOM is read from the same single profiled run that produces the nsys report.
# nsys lowers it (measured on quicksilver: 5.631e6 clean vs 5.27-5.33e6 profiled,
# -5.4%..-6.4%), so every JSON carries fom_from_profiled_run=true. Do not compare
# these values against published unprofiled FOMs without that correction.
